coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Coinbase

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your north star is payment success rate, and that depends on payment services staying fast and correct under heavy volume. At Lumen Payments I cut the p99 latency of the payment status API from 480 ms to 120 ms by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis. I also designed and ran the settlement service, which processed about 40 million events a day on Kafka.

As a Senior Software Engineer, I owned that work from design through deployment and production support. I was on call for the payments platform and wrote the post-incident reviews for 14 incidents, which taught me how much precision and auditability matter in high-volume transactional systems. I also led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, so building scalable, fault-tolerant services in a service-oriented architecture is familiar ground. My production work is in Kotlin, Java and Python rather than Go, but the API design and event-driven architecture habits carry over, and I'm ready to build the platform primitives and self-serve APIs that let other Coinbase teams add new payment rails.

I spent 2023 to early 2025 caring for a family member, and I've returned to full-time engineering with my AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification (2024) behind me. I'd welcome a conversation about how I can help the Payments team raise payment success rate, and I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Best regards,
Priya Raman

I also led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, so I know how to own delivery from design through production. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm available to start a conversation any weekday and can begin a new role on four weeks' notice.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
